title: Calculating Our Own Footprint: Regen Studio's 2025 Carbon Inventory
subtitle: 8.6 tonnes, two long-haul flights, and a −40% reduction lever we can actually see
featuredImageAlt: Regen Studio 2025 carbon inventory — Scope 3 dominated by long-haul flights
excerpt: We measured our own 2025 footprint: 8.6 tonnes CO₂e, with ~95% coming from two long-haul flights between São Paulo and Amsterdam. Here is what we learned about doing this honestly — as a one-person company, without a consultancy invoice, using a tool we built ourselves.
